extracted.intended_audience: Conan Exiles players, PC (Steam) owners, private server operators, and modders
extracted.subtask_short: game update FAQ for Conan Exiles
extracted.subtask_description: An official announcement and FAQ describing the Conan Exiles Enhanced (Unreal Engine 5) upgrade: features, platform availability, save-transfer procedures, server behavior, mod and purchase compatibility, and system requirements. Targeted at players, server hosts, and modders preparing for the May 5 release.

rubrics_metrics.name: Performance target
rubrics_metrics.description: With the advanced capabilities of Unreal Engine 5, Conan Exiles Enhanced targets smooth 60+ FPS gameplay across Low, Medium, High, and Ultra settings on most PCs, while also delivering strong performance on Steam Deck.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an explicit performance goal for the Enhanced edition; users on lower-end hardware should consult the minimum/recommended system requirements and expect varied results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Merged Worlds (Exiled Lands & Isle of Siptah)
rubrics_metrics.description: Merged Worlds: Exiled Lands & Isle of Siptah – Explore both regions with the same character, teleporting between maps with no restart required. Access to the Isle of Siptah still requires ownership of the Isle of Siptah DLC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Players who own the Isle of Siptah DLC retain access; because the merge changed physical coordinates, bases on Isle of Siptah cannot be preserved in the UE5 update (see save-transfer guidance).

rubrics_metrics.name: DLC ownership required for Siptah access
rubrics_metrics.description: Access to the Isle of Siptah still requires ownership of the Isle of Siptah DLC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Even though maps are merged into a single experience, owning the DLC remains a prerequisite to access its content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiple characters per account
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiple Characters Support: Maintain and switch between multiple single-player characters per account.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adds support for multiple single-player characters tied to an account; expected to simplify alternate-character play without needing multiple installs or saves.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revamped user interface
rubrics_metrics.description: Revamped User Interface: Cleaner menus and improved navigation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interface changes intended to improve usability; players should expect different menu layouts and navigation flows when using Enhanced.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhanced crafting and building behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: Enhanced Crafting and Building: Crafting takes ingredients from nearby storage and follower inventories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Crafting automation/quality-of-life change: materials in nearby containers and followers are considered when crafting, which changes resource management and building workflows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Day-one mod support and Mod Dev Kit refresh
rubrics_metrics.description: Day one Modding Support: Several popular mods ready at launch, with a refreshed Mod Dev Kit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mods are supported on launch but some may need upgrades to be compatible; developers/modders should use the refreshed Mod Dev Kit and coordinate with Funcom/Inflexion for compatibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Save transfer support from UE4 to UE5
rubrics_metrics.description: Save transfer support: Carry over your progress from the Exiled Lands, including characters, bases, and loot, or start fresh in a revitalized world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: UE4 Exiled Lands database files will be readable in UE5 and can carry forward characters and structures for Exiled Lands; Isle of Siptah bases cannot be preserved due to map coordinate changes. Backups are strongly recommended prior to update.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reduced client size
rubrics_metrics.description: Reduced Client Size: The client has been trimmed down to 68GB—nearly half of its previous 120GB—making it a far more practical choice for users with limited storage capacity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Storage footprint reduction is a stated objective; users should still ensure SSD and sufficient free space per system requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Platform availability at launch
rubrics_metrics.description: This upgrade will be available to all current and future owners of Conan Exiles on Steam starting May 5th.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: At launch, Enhanced is Steam-only on PC. Epic Games Store, Microsoft Store, Xbox and PlayStation are not supported at launch, though later ports are being considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: UE4 version (Conan Exiles Legacy) availability and limitations
rubrics_metrics.description: The UE4 version will remain available to those who want to play it. The UE4 version will remain available on consoles (Xbox, PlayStation) and PC players can switch to Conan Exiles Legacy via Steam 'Game Versions & Betas'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conan Exiles Legacy will not receive new major content updates, support, access to the Bazaar, or official servers on PC once Enhanced launches. Crom Coins will no longer be valid on UE4 PC versions after Enhanced goes live.

rubrics_metrics.name: Crom Coins and purchase carry-over policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Yes—everything you own comes with you. Crom Coins, Bazaar items, DLC, and Twitch Drops will all be available in the Enhanced version. Note: Any purchases made in the UE5 version will not apply to the UE4 Conan Exiles Legacy version.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Crom Coins will carry over for Steam players who move to Enhanced; however, Crom Coins will no longer be valid on UE4 PC versions once Enhanced is live. Players who wish to remain on UE4 Legacy should spend currency before May 5.

rubrics_metrics.name: One-way upgrade rule (UE4 -> UE5)
rubrics_metrics.description: While UE4 databases will be readable by UE5, the reverse is not true. Once your character or your game database is updated to UE5, you will not be able to transfer it back to UE4.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If players want to keep characters/savegames in Conan Exiles Legacy, migrate characters off Official servers and back up database files prior to May 5. Backups can be used to restore UE4 play if needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Official server downtime and migration timeline
rubrics_metrics.description: On May 4th, 15:00 UTC, all Official PC servers will be brought down in anticipation of the update to Conan Exiles Enhanced (UE5). The entire server database will be updated to UE5, including your character.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan ahead for this scheduled downtime; once updated on official servers, characters cannot be moved back to Legacy. Isle of Siptah official servers will be closed and characters migrated to Exiled Lands servers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Isle of Siptah bases non-transferability
rubrics_metrics.description: Because the island itself has been merged with the Exiled Lands... bases on the Isle of Siptah cannot be preserved in the UE5 update.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommended prep: dismantle bases and store materials in followers' inventories prior to official server downtime; if in a clan, leave the clan and transfer followers to individual characters using trading posts to preserve materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Private server backup recommendations and game.db handling
rubrics_metrics.description: Private server owners will have the option to continue playing in UE4 using Conan Exiles Legacy. Prior to the May 5th update, it is recommended to make backups of the following game database files... (paths provided).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Private server owners must ensure correct game database file (game.db) is placed in the corresponding folder for Conan Exiles Enhanced to carry forward characters and structures. Backing up these files is a precaution; folder name changes will occur after the update.

rubrics_metrics.name: Single-player backup recommendations
rubrics_metrics.description: Prior to the May 5th update, it is recommended to make backups of the following game database files... (paths provided).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Single-player save owners should back up game.db and dlc_siptah.db as appropriate; backups allow recovery if upgrade issues occur and are needed to run Conan Exiles Legacy after the update.

rubrics_metrics.name: UE4 Server Transfer Tool restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: Characters from single-player games are not allowed to be imported to dedicated servers of any kind, private servers cannot be imported to an official server, PvE characters cannot be imported to a PvP server. Characters can be imported to a server of equal or lesser restrictiveness... In addition, there is a one-day cooldown that applies to character transfers using the Server Transfer Tool.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These restrictions are enforced to prevent exploits and game-breaking issues; players must plan transfers within the listed compatibility ladder and respect the cooldown.

rubrics_metrics.name: Server/client version matching requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Your client version must match the version of the server. All official PC servers will be updated to UE5, and because the UE5 update is only available on Steam, this unfortunately means players on Epic Games Store and Windows Store will not be able to access official servers from launch.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Players cannot join official servers running a different engine/version than their client. For Epic/MS store users, private/self-hosted servers or switching to Steam may be necessary to play on official servers until ports are available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Server structure and fresh start servers
rubrics_metrics.description: All existing Official Exiled Lands PC servers will be updated to UE5. All Official Isle of Siptah PC servers will be closed... A number of 'fresh start' official PC servers will be launched in each region to allow players to experience the game from the very beginning.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Players seeking a clean experience can use fresh start servers; those wanting continuity should follow save-transfer and migration guidance prior to downtime.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rented/server hosting support plan
rubrics_metrics.description: We’re working with select hosting providers to support the UE5 version at launch. For details about your server, please contact your hosting provider directly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Not all hosting companies may be ready at launch; private server owners should verify readiness with their provider and prepare backups if needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mod compatibility guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: The new version fully supports mods, but some might need to be upgraded to work with Conan Exiles Enhanced. We are currently working with modders to make sure as many as possible will be supported in the new version of Conan Exiles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mod authors should test and upgrade mods using the refreshed Mod Dev Kit; players should expect some mods to be unavailable until updated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purchase and Bazaar behavior across versions
rubrics_metrics.description: The UE4 version will not receive additional updates, support, access to the Bazaar, or official servers. Note: Crom Coins will no longer be valid on the UE4 (Conan Exiles Legacy) PC versions once Conan Exiles Enhanced goes live as the Bazaar will be disabled on PC in Conan Exiles Legacy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Players who remain on UE4 Legacy will lose Bazaar access and Crom Coins utility on PC; purchases made in UE5 will not apply to UE4 Legacy.

rubrics_metrics.name: System requirements for Enhanced
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed Conan Exiles Enhanced: MINIMUM: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system. OS: Windows 10 64bit. Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or Intel Core i5-10400F. Memory: 16 GB RAM. Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1070Ti or Radeon 5700 XT, minimum 8 GB Video RAM. DirectX: Version 12. Network: Broadband Internet connection. Storage: SSD required. RECOMMENDED: OS: Windows 11 64bit. Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 5600X or Intel Core i7-11700F. Memory: 16 GB RAM. Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6700. DirectX: Version 12. Network: Broadband Internet connection. Storage: SSD required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Players should compare their hardware to these specs; SSD is required. Performance target (60+ FPS) is contingent on meeting or exceeding recommended specifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Migration options for different server types
rubrics_metrics.description: Official Servers: Official PC servers will be updated to UE5 and Isle of Siptah servers closed and merged. Private Servers: Process differs for Exiled Lands and Isle of Siptah; private server owners can continue on UE4 if they choose. Single-player: Exiled Lands DBs should be readable in UE5 and conversion is expected to be seamless, with backups recommended.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the detailed per-server-type instructions in the FAQ (including creating new Exiled Lands servers in UE4, using Server Transfer Tool, and backing up DB files) to preserve characters and facilitate migration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recommendation to dismantle Isle of Siptah bases
rubrics_metrics.description: The best option for Isle of Siptah players is to prepare for the UE5 update by dismantling their bases and depositing the materials in the inventories of their followers prior to the Official server downtime on May 4th, 15:00 UTC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dismantling and storing materials in followers (and transferring followers if in a clan) is the recommended mitigation to preserve rebuild materials, since bases cannot be preserved in the merge.
